⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Excellent Service and Hospitality

It was a great experience staying at the Redbrick Hotel. The service and food were both exceptional. A special thanks to Upendra ji, the receptionist, for his warm welcome, professionalism, and helpful nature. He ensured our stay was comfortable and pleasant from check-in to check-out. His courteous behavior and attention to detail truly enhanced our experience. Highly recommended for anyone visiting this hotel!

negative_snippets: The rooms are quite small and in need of some serious maintenance. Food is good, not oily or unhealthy. Bathrooms are clean. Good value if you're looking for a decent place in a safe area in Gurgaon.
